title: Dried Ghast, no Craft?
description: A simple Data Pack that removes the Dried Ghast crafting recipe
body:
The Minecraft Community has been vocal about wanting the Dried Ghast Crafting Recipe removed. Personally I don't think it's a great idea, but I won't stop em!

This Data Pack does one simple thing, it removes the Dried Ghast Crafting Recipe.

**For updates you can follow me on [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/8onfire.com)!** I'm the creator of #mcartday, as well as a Game Texture Artist, 3D Model Artist, 3D Animator, Gameplay Designer, and Content Creator in the Minecraft Space.

**Like this data pack? You can donate me on [Kofi](https://ko-fi.com/8onfire) to help support more projects like this!**
